item.title: Partial Shutdown Looms as DHS Funding Approaches Deadline
item.description: While the rest of the federal government is funded through September, DHS funding remains in limbo. Funding for the department is set to expire Friday night. If it does, it will be the third shutdown of President Trump’s second term.

item.title: George Washington’s Mount Vernon Celebrates Presidents’ Day, Displays Rare Items
item.description: MOUNT VERNON, VA - This President's Day, thousands of people visited the home of America's first President, George Washington. Visitors could get a chance to meet with actors impersonating Washington and other key figures from the 18th century as well as viewing other performances. As part of America's 250th celebrations, visitors get a chance to view never-before-displayed items of Washington's.

item.title: Campaigning to Cartography: Both Parties Look to Redraw the Road to Power in 2026 Midterms
item.description: The midterm elections this fall may not be entirely decided by debates and campaign ads. The battle for control of Congress in the 2026 midterms is changing — from campaigning to cartography.

item.title: The Rev. Jesse Jackson Remembered by U.S. Leaders as a National Voice for Justice
item.description: An early follow and mentee of the Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., Jackson became a national voice for justice. Today, leaders in Washington and across the country are honoring his legacy.

item.title: Military Tension Increases Amid Iran Nuclear Negotiations in Geneva
item.description: Tensions are rising again between the United States and Iran, with new threats and military escalation, as high-stakes talks between the two countries take place in Geneva.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine Peace Talks Wrap in Geneva, Five Year Anniversary of War Approaching
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. – Peace talks between the US, Ukraine and Russia wrapped in Geneva after two days. It’s been almost five years since Russia launched their latest war against Ukraine. “There’s progress but none of the details can be disclosed at this stage,” said Rustem Umerov, Secretary for the National Defense and Security Council of Ukraine. item.title: Day 5 of Partial Govt. Shutdown as DHS Funding Standoff Continues, FEMA Disruptions Emerge
item.description: The partial shutdown is impacting the Department of Homeland Security, which oversees agencies like ICE, the Coast Guard, FEMA and TSA.

item.title: Trump to make Decision on Potential Military Strike on Iran Within Two Weeks
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - During President Trump’s Board of Peace meeting, he said he will make a decision on whether to carry out a potential military strike on Iran within the next two weeks. This follows reports of a large US military build-up in the region.

item.title: Board of Peace Members, U.S. Pledge Billions for Gaza Relief, Reconstruction
item.description: At the first-ever Board of Peace Summit in Washington, President Donald Trump rolled out new financial commitments and security pledges aimed at stabilizing and rebuilding Gaza.
